title: gray insulated black out curtains
text: gray insulated black out curtains. Thick, as you would hope and works really well.  The silver rod loops are large - I'm guessing it will fit up to a 2" rod.  I did get my hand steamer out and work on a couple of fold lines and crinkles after a quick toss in the dryer didn't remove all the creases.  I do like these.  I chose the lighter of the grays  - I think there was a darker gray?  It is a true gray - lighter, NOT a taupe or green gray.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
